scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Northstar Shuttle Authority’s service-alert release-note dry run able to show the planned route-renumber example tomorrow.
Emerging Need: The example depends on an agency-approved old-stop-to-new-route crosswalk that is not attached while the release-note shell moves toward same-day freeze.
Decision Context: Early calendar information leaves the example optional; later account, contact, shell, and cutoff records establish the missing prerequisite, an approaching supplement window, and a misleading non-authorized inbox. The approved data owner is only in shared account records.
Consequence: If the crosswalk path is not opened before freeze, the dry run can proceed but loses the client-specific route-renumber example.

parameter.title: Northstar service-alert release note dry run
parameter.description: Review the draft bulletin structure for December service-alert and route-renumber communications. Client-specific example table remains a placeholder until product-copy check.

parameter.subject: Northstar wants the route-renumber example in tomorrow's dry run
parameter.body: Northstar's comms lead asked that tomorrow's release-note dry run include the old-stop-to-new-route example if the source data is cleared. The release shell will open a supplement slot once QA marks the placeholder ready this afternoon.

parameter.name: Northstar Training Desk
parameter.notes: Handles webinar attendance and routine training questions for Northstar sessions; not a source-data approval contact.

parameter.content: Northstar release-note shell is ready for supplement review. The old-stop-to-new-route table placeholder is empty; copy QA says client-specific examples freeze at 16:00 CT, and the blank slot will be dropped from tomorrow's dry-run snapshot if no approved crosswalk is attached before then.

parameter.title: Northstar release-note supplement gate
parameter.content: Final supplement check for Northstar dry-run snapshot: approved source attachment must be in the release-note shell before the 16:00 CT freeze; late files will not be included tomorrow.

parameter.subject: Northstar dry-run snapshot generated without route-renumber supplement
parameter.body: The Northstar release-note supplement lane closed at 16:00 CT. No approved crosswalk attachment was present in the shell, so the generated dry-run snapshot excludes the old-stop-to-new-route example table.
